race.comment: RIMBAUD (4) has been a model of consistency for the Archibald stable this campaign and finds another suitable contest. He'll bounce straight to the front and prove tough to run down. SUPERALLOY (16) doesn't win out of turn but is going better than his form reads. Pozman's 3kg claim sets him up nicely from a cosy draw. MELDUBIOUS (14) hasn't done much wrong this prep and finds another nice race. Thompson takes back over. Remains firmly in the mix. IRAMA (5) won well at this track last start and while up in grade, he appears capable of taking that next step.
